judgment.rationale: Window Hopper groups eligible windows by process image. The report proves application specificity but not whether Rider windows are separate processes, filtered types, or inaccessible by privilege.
evidence: Window Hopper 0.101.2362 works in other applications but shows no thumbnails for multiple Rider windows.
Window Hopper enumerates Alt-Tab-eligible windows and keeps only exact resolved process-image matches.
No ZIP, Rider version, process topology, or elevation state was supplied.

comment.body: Thanks for the clear Rider-only reproduction and confirmation that several shortcut choices work in other apps. Please invoke Window Hopper while a Rider window is foreground, then add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward. Also state Rider's exact version, whether Rider or PowerToys is elevated, and whether the open Rider windows belong to one Rider process or separate `rider64.exe` processes (Task Manager Details is sufficient). Those facts determine whether the failure is window eligibility, process grouping, or privilege-related.
